craft_notes: Sthāyin: triple-image (net/dream/mirage-city). Sanskrit: asāratayā + śakrajālavad + māyāsvapnopamam + gandharvanagarabhramam → L4 keeps all three uncut (never drop an image). Rows: row 2 (images whole). Close: error (last noun). Minimal pass: none. Read aloud: net, dream, city (three beats). Rejected: 'illusion' as single term — killed: three specific images; 'phantom' — killed: error kept.

lines: Known by its own unsubstantialness, Goddess —
Indra-net, māyā's dream, the Gandharva-city's error.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tad asāratayā devi vijñeyaṃ śakrajālavat | māyāsvapnopamaṃ caiva gandharvanagarabhramam

reads_against.argmap: How should that form be known? → The form is known only as unsubstantial — dream, net, mirage-city.
c1_essence: Known by unsubstantialness: Indra-net, māyā-dream, Gandharva-city.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with jijñāsā (wonder sharpened into seeking)
